LESSON: READING COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Vocabulary Building (2 sessions) • Vocabulary buildi
Topic 2.7: Reading Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading Comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is reading important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. respond to direct questions from a text for comprehension

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches Reading Comprehension for Grade 5 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. respond to direct questions from a text for comprehension
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading Comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading Comprehension above.
2. Explain Reading Comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading Comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading Comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading Comprehension important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is reading important?
2. How do direct questions help in understanding a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. respond to direct questions from a text for comprehension

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
